arabic text: ME KHAAK PA SOJAUNGI HA KEHTI HU(N) BABA,\nSINE PE SULANE KO KAHA KEHTI HU(N) BABA
english translation text: I WILL SLEEP ON THE DUSTY GROUND, BABA\nI WILL NOT ASK TO SLEEP ON YOUR CHEST, BABA

arabic text: KEHTI HU(N) KE CHEHRA HI DIKHAJAYIYE BABA\nMARNE SE MERE PEHLE HI AAJAYIYE BABA\nPEHLU ME CHHUPANE KO KAHA KETI HU(N) BABA
english translation text: PLEASE SHOW ME YOUR FACE, BABA,\nPLEASE COME BEFORE I DIE, BABA,\nI AM NOT ASKING YOU TO TAKE ME IN YOUR ARMS, BABA

arabic text: BACHE TO BOHOT CHHOTE HUWA KARTE HAI BABA\nHAR AIK MUSIBAT PE GILA KARTE HAI BABA\nME NAAZ UTHANE KO KAHA KEHTI HU(N) BABA
english translation text: CHILDREN ARE VERY SMALL AND INNOCENT, BABA\nTHEY TEND TO COMPLAIN ABOUT ANY DIFFICULTY THAT BEFALLS THEM, BABA\nBUT I WILL NOT ASK YOU TO PAMPER ME, BABA,

arabic text: SEHLUNGI JO HAATHON KI LAKIRON ME LIKHA HAI\nZINDAAN KI ANDHERON KA GILA KISNE KIYA HAI\nME SHAMME JALANE KO KAHA KEHTI HU(N) BABA
english translation text: I WILL FACE WHATEVER IS IN MY DESTINY, BABA,\nI WILL NOT COMPLAIN ABOUT THE DARKNESS OF THE PRISON, BABA\nI WILL NOT ASK FOR CANDLES TO BE LIT IN THE PRISON, BABA

arabic text: HAAYE BABA, BABA MERE BACHPAN KA TAQAZA TO NAHI THA\nKHABON ME KHILONE THE JANAZA TO NAHI THA\nGHODI ME KHILANE KO KAHA KEHTI HU(N) BABA
english translation text: O FATHER, IT IS UNUSUAL FOR CHILDREN MY AGE,\nTO SEE THE BODIES OF THEIR LOVED ONES, INSTEAD OF PLAYING WITH THEIR TOYS,\nI AM NOT ASKING YOU TO PLAY WITH ME IN YOUR LAP, BABA

arabic text: BABA MERE ZAKHMON KI DAWA KON KAREGA\nAB JAAN SAKINA KO BHALA KON KAHEGA\nPEHLU ME CHHUPANE KO KAHA KETI HU(N) BABA
english translation text: O FATHER, WHO WILL HEAL MY WOUNDS,\nNOW WHO WILL CALL SAKINA DARLING,\nI AM NOT ASKING YOU TO TAKE ME IN YOUR ARMS, BABA
